_comment: MSINDO periodic Cyclic Cluster Model (CCM) reference data for vibe-qc parity validation. Generated out-of-process (CLAUDE.md §10) by examples/regression/msindo/gen_ccm_reference.py against a local MSINDO 2025 build. 1-D cyclic clusters: He chain (covalent, NOEWALD) and alternating H-F ionic chains (with/without Madelung). Geometry in Angstrom, energy in Hartree. madelung_nuclear_energy = MSINDO 'MADELUNG-NUCLEAR ENERGY' (WS-weighted core-core point-charge sum). ws_cells = per-atom WS neighbour table (1-based origin ids + partial-count weights, PRINTOPTS=CCMWSC).

clusters.name: hf_dilute_chain
clusters.note: molecular-limit anchor: CCM1D reduces to isolated HF

clusters.name: he5_a2.5_noewald
clusters.note: 5-atom He chain (odd N, all WS weights 1.0); s-only periodic, no Madelung

clusters.name: hfionic_a1.6_n1_madelung
clusters.note: 1-unit H-F ionic chain with Madelung (CCM1D Ewald)

clusters.name: hfionic_a1.6_n2_madelung
clusters.note: 2-unit H-F ionic chain with Madelung (CCM1D Ewald)

clusters.name: he_sc_2x2x2_a2.5_noewald
clusters.note: 3-D simple-cubic He (2x2x2 supercell), covalent periodic, no Madelung

clusters.name: hf_rocksalt_a4.0_noewald
clusters.note: 3-D rocksalt H-F (MgO structure type), no Madelung

clusters.name: hf_rocksalt_a4.0_madelung
clusters.note: 3-D rocksalt H-F (MgO structure type) with 3-D Ewald Madelung

clusters.name: mgo_rocksalt_a4.21_madelung
clusters.note: 3-D rocksalt MgO (Mg4O4 cell) with 3-D Ewald Madelung — real ionic oxide

clusters.name: he_layer_a2.5_noewald
clusters.note: 2-D square He monolayer, covalent surface, no Madelung

clusters.name: hf_layer_a1.6_madelung
clusters.note: 2-D flat H-F checkerboard monolayer with 2-D Ewald Madelung (in-plane)

clusters.name: mgo_100_slab_a2.105_madelung
clusters.note: 2-D MgO(100) bilayer slab with 2-D Ewald Madelung — adsorption substrate

clusters.name: mgo_100_water_a2.105_madelung
clusters.note: 2-D MgO(100) slab + H2O adlayer (CCM2D Madelung) — oxide adsorption

clusters.name: mgo_100_ch4_a2.105_madelung
clusters.note: 2-D MgO(100) slab + CH4 adlayer (organic; CCM2D Madelung)

gradient_clusters.name: mgo_100_slab
gradient_clusters.note: symmetric MgO(100) 2-layer slab (CCM2D Madelung); in-plane forces vanish by symmetry, out-of-plane forces relax the interlayer spacing

gradient_clusters.name: mgo_bulk_distorted
gradient_clusters.note: MgO rocksalt with one O displaced (CCM3D Madelung)
